job.title: Senior Security Engineer, Proactive Security - Platform
job.pay_full: $159,800 – $235,000 a year national base pay range, plus opportunities for equity grants

details.about: DoorDash's Proactive Security Engineering team builds the paved paths that engineers across DoorDash, Wolt and Deliveroo use to access infrastructure, manage secrets and authenticate services. The global Security Engineering Platform team builds and runs tier-0 services for access management, secret storage and identity, including an in-house Access Platform, Teleport and HashiCorp Vault. The aim is to make the secure path the easiest one. The role reports to the Manager of the Proactive Security Engineering Platform team.
duties: Design, build and harden paved paths for privileged access, secrets management and identity
Threat model, security review and test tier-0 security services and their integrations, and drive findings to remediation
Build self-service tooling, SDKs, Terraform modules and integrations for just-in-time access, short-lived credentials and dynamic secrets
Help drive migrations off long-lived credentials and standing access
Partner with Core Infrastructure, Compute, Data and product engineering to integrate paved paths into Kubernetes, CI/CD, AWS and GCP
Join a follow-the-sun on-call rotation for tier-0 security services, and improve monitoring, runbooks, incident response and root cause analysis
Help enable secure adoption of AI tooling and agentic workflows through access control and secrets brokering for agents
needs: 6+ years as a Security, Infrastructure or Platform Engineer at an internet scale organization
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Security Engineering, a related field or equivalent work experience
Strong software engineering skills in one or more object oriented languages (e.g. Go, Java, Kotlin), building security tooling, controls and production services
Hands-on experience with access management and secret storage systems, such as PAM, secrets management or key management platforms
Working knowledge of identity and authentication standards such as OIDC, SAML, mTLS and workload identity
Working knowledge of distributed systems concepts, including replication, consistency and distributed consensus
Experience with Kubernetes, Terraform or other infrastructure as code, and AWS and/or GCP IAM
Experience with threat modeling, security design review and root cause analysis for security incidents
Experience running highly available services with mature on-call practices
Strong problem solving and clear verbal and written communication
nice: Experience with Teleport or HashiCorp Vault
details.benefits: National base pay range $159,800 – $235,000 a year; starting pay depends on skills, experience, qualifications, work location and market conditions. Compensation also includes opportunities for equity grants. Benefits include a 401(k) plan with employer matching, 16 weeks of paid parental leave, wellness benefits, commuter benefits match, medical, dental and vision benefits, 11 paid holidays, disability and basic life insurance, family-forming assistance and a mental health program. Salaried roles get flexible paid time off plus 80 hours of paid sick time a year.
notes: DoorDash expects this position to be filled by 12/30/2026
DoorDash says it will never ask applicants to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring

scenes.head: About the team
bullets: Paved paths for DoorDash, Wolt & Deliveroo
lines: This team builds the paved paths that engineers across DoorDash, Wolt, and Deliveroo use to reach infrastructure, manage secrets, and authenticate services.
It runs the company's most critical security services for access, secret storage, and identity, including an in-house access platform, Teleport, and HashiCorp Vault.
The goal is simple: make the secure path the easiest path.

scenes.head: What you'll do
lines: You'll design and harden paved paths for privileged access, secrets, and identity.
You'll threat model and test these services, then see the findings through to a fix.
You'll build self-service tools, S D Ks, and Terraform modules, so teams can adopt just-in-time access and short-lived credentials without filing a ticket.
You'll help move the company off long-lived credentials, and work with infrastructure teams across Kubernetes, A W S, and Google Cloud.
You'll also join a follow-the-sun on-call rotation.
